name: Minette
source:
Minette "Miette" (Last Name Withheld) 
Domestic Chimera (Unknown Combination , Chimaera domesticus. Suspected Sorex araneus and Pachyuromys duprasi traits inherited)

An unfortunate shut-in with no living relatives. She feels like she hasn't done anything with her life and thinks she never will. Running on fumes. Doesn't remember much of her childhood, but had a relatively good relationship with her parents.

Fun fact: Her whiskers twitch while she eats.
